title: Binary digits of a power-of-two multiple
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $p$ with $C\ne 0$, the binary digit list of $C\cdot 2^p$ is the concatenation of $p$ zero bits followed by the binary digit list of $C$.
replaced:
For every $C \neq 0$ and every $p$, the binary-digit list of $C \cdot 2^p$
consists of $p$ false bits followed by the binary digits of $C$.
